blocks.text: Market research us bazaar ka data (maloomat) jama karne ka process (tareeqa) hai jis mein aap ka karobar kaam karta hai. Is data se customers ki zarooratein, pasand aur behaviors (log kaise khareedte aur kya karte hain) samajh aate hain, aur competitors ki strengths (khoobiyan) aur weaknesses (kamzoriyan) bhi. Market research ke do bare tareeqe hain: qualitative (baaton aur raye wala) aur quantitative (adad aur ginti wala).

blocks.prompt: Market research ke do bare tareeqe bataiye.

items: Market research ke do tareeqe: qualitative aur quantitative.
